text: ポケモンが　いうこと　きくか　どうかは　ひとの　うでまえ　しだい　なんだもの

structure.jp: ポケモンが　いうこと　きくか　どうかは
structure.en: whether a Pokémon obeys or not

structure.jp: ひとの　うでまえ　しだい

patterns.name: 〜かどうか
patterns.explanation: かどうか after a verb means 'whether or not' it happens. きくか　どうか = 'whether it listens or not'.

patterns.name: 〜しだい
patterns.explanation: しだい right after a thing says the result depends on that thing. うでまえ　しだい = 'depends on skill'.

patterns.name: 〜んだもの
patterns.explanation: んだもの at the end gives a reason with feeling, like 'because, after all', and sounds a little feminine or childlike. しだい　なんだもの = 'it depends on that, after all'.
